title: Size bound under pairing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify whether the new gates are AND or OR, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuits on $n$ variables. Pairing the circuits according to the given pairing construction does not increase the sum of their sizes plus the length of the list: the resulting sum of sizes plus resulting list length is at most the original sum of sizes plus original list length.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a list of circuits on $n$ variables
